blocks.text: U.S. President Donald Trump reaffirmed a mutual defense alliance with the Philippines on Wednesday, expressing willingness to expand defense cooperation between the two Pacific countries. In his talks with Philippine President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. in Manila, Trump also called for greater collaboration between the two countries in many areas, including energy security, and referred to the possibility of a civilian nuclear energy project in the Southeast Asian country. “America’s civilian nuclear industry is also the best and most advanced in the world, and we’re dealing with you on that,” he said. “And for the Philippines to embrace American technology in its […]...
